# Appendix

## A: Complete function files

For the workshop starter project. Each function file is copy-pasteable.

### R/functions/modelling_functions.R

```{r, eval = FALSE}
#' Fit body mass ~ flipper length on pre-filtered data
#'
#' @param data A data frame, assumed to contain a single species.
#'   Must have `body_mass_g` and `flipper_length_mm` columns.
#' @param response Bare column name for the response. Default
#'   `body_mass_g`.
#' @param predictor Bare column name for the predictor. Default
#'   `flipper_length_mm`.
#' @return A fitted lm object.
fit_model <- function(data,
                      response = body_mass_g,
                      predictor = flipper_length_mm) {
  lm({{ response }} ~ {{ predictor }}, data = data)
}

#' Tidy a fitted lm with confidence intervals
#'
#' @param model A fitted lm object.
#' @param conf_level Confidence level for intervals. Default 0.95.
#' @return A tibble of tidied coefficients.
tidy_model <- function(model, conf_level = 0.95) {
  broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = conf_level)
}

#' Fit and tidy for one species (script-style wrapper)
#'
#' @param data A data frame with a `species` column.
#' @param sp Character of length 1. Species to filter to.
#' @param conf_level Confidence level for intervals. Default 0.95.
#' @return A tibble of tidied coefficients with a `species` column.
fit_species_model <- function(data, sp, conf_level = 0.95) {

  if (!sp %in% unique(data$species)) {
    stop(
      "Species '", sp, "' is not in the data. ",
      "Available species: ",
      paste(sort(unique(data$species)), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  data |>
    dplyr::filter(species == sp) |>
    fit_model() |>
    tidy_model(conf_level = conf_level) |>
    dplyr::mutate(species = sp, .before = 1)
}
```

### R/functions/plotting_functions.R

```{r, eval = FALSE}
#' Scatter plot of body mass vs flipper length for one species
#' (script-style: takes full data and a species name)
#'
#' @param data A data frame with `species`, `body_mass_g`, and
#'   `flipper_length_mm`.
#' @param sp Character of length 1. Species to plot.
#' @return A ggplot object.
make_scatter_plot <- function(data, sp) {
  data |>
    dplyr::filter(species == sp) |>
    make_scatter_plot_from_data()
}

#' Scatter plot from pre-filtered single-species data
#' (pipeline-style: takes already-filtered data)
#'
#' @param data A data frame assumed to be one species' worth.
#' @return A ggplot object.
make_scatter_plot_from_data <- function(data) {
  sp <- unique(data$species)
  ggplot2::ggplot(data,
                  ggplot2::aes(flipper_length_mm, body_mass_g)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    ggplot2::labs(title = sp,
                  x = "Flipper length (mm)",
                  y = "Body mass (g)") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal()
}
```



## Appendix B: Complete test file

### tests/test_modelling_functions.R

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(testthat)
source(here::here("R", "functions", "modelling_functions.R"))

test_data <- readRDS(
  here::here("tests", "fixtures", "penguins_test_subset.rds")
)

# ---- fit_species_model ----

test_that("fit_species_model returns a tibble", {
  out <- fit_species_model(test_data, "Adelie")
  expect_s3_class(out, "tbl_df")
})

test_that("fit_species_model has the expected columns", {
  out <- fit_species_model(test_data, "Adelie")
  expect_named(
    out,
    c("species", "term", "estimate", "std.error",
      "statistic", "p.value", "conf.low", "conf.high")
  )
})

test_that("fit_species_model labels species correctly", {
  out <- fit_species_model(test_data, "Gentoo")
  expect_true(all(out$species == "Gentoo"))
})

test_that("fit_species_model returns intercept and one slope", {
  out <- fit_species_model(test_data, "Chinstrap")
  expect_equal(nrow(out), 2)
})

test_that("fit_species_model rejects unknown species", {
  expect_error(
    fit_species_model(test_data, "gentoo"),
    regexp = "not in the data"
  )
})

test_that("conf_level controls interval width", {
  out_95 <- fit_species_model(test_data, "Adelie", conf_level = 0.95)
  out_99 <- fit_species_model(test_data, "Adelie", conf_level = 0.99)
  width_95 <- out_95$conf.high - out_95$conf.low
  width_99 <- out_99$conf.high - out_99$conf.low
  expect_true(all(width_99 > width_95))
})

# ---- fit_model ----

test_that("fit_model defaults reproduce previous behaviour", {
  adelie <- test_data |> dplyr::filter(species == "Adelie")
  m_old <- lm(body_mass_g ~ flipper_length_mm, data = adelie)
  m_new <- fit_model(adelie)
  expect_equal(coef(m_old), coef(m_new))
})

test_that("fit_model accepts alternative response and predictor", {
  adelie <- test_data |> dplyr::filter(species == "Adelie")
  m <- fit_model(adelie,
                 response = bill_length_mm,
                 predictor = bill_depth_mm)
  expect_s3_class(m, "lm")
  expect_equal(names(coef(m)),
               c("(Intercept)", "bill_depth_mm"))
})

# ---- tidy_model ----

test_that("tidy_model returns broom output", {
  adelie <- test_data |> dplyr::filter(species == "Adelie")
  m <- fit_model(adelie)
  out <- tidy_model(m)
  expect_s3_class(out, "tbl_df")
  expect_true("conf.low" %in% names(out))
})
```



## Appendix C: Complete `_targets.R`

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# _targets.R
library(targets)
library(tarchetypes)

tar_option_set(
  packages = c("dplyr", "tidyr", "purrr", "broom",
               "ggplot2", "readr", "here", "janitor",
               "patchwork", "rlang"),
  format   = "qs",
  seed     = 1234
)

tar_source(files = "R/functions")

list(

  # ---- Data ingestion ----
  tar_target(
    raw_file,
    here::here("data", "penguins.csv"),
    format = "file"
  ),

  tar_target(
    penguins_raw,
    readr::read_csv(raw_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  ),

  tar_target(
    penguins_clean,
    penguins_raw |>
      janitor::clean_names() |>
      tidyr::drop_na(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, species)
  ),

  # ---- Branching index ----
  tar_target(
    species_name,
    sort(unique(penguins_clean$species))
  ),

  # ---- Per-species data ----
  tar_target(
    species_data,
    penguins_clean |> dplyr::filter(species == species_name),
    pattern = map(species_name)
  ),

  # ---- Per-species model ----
  tar_target(
    species_model,
    fit_model(species_data),
    pattern = map(species_data)
  ),

  tar_target(
    species_coefs,
    tidy_model(species_model) |>
      dplyr::mutate(species = species_name, .before = 1),
    pattern = map(species_model, species_name)
  ),

  # ---- Combined coefficient table ----
  tar_target(
    coefficient_table,
    species_coefs
  ),

  tar_target(
    coefficient_csv,
    {
      path <- here::here("outputs", "tables", "coefficients.csv")
      if (!dir.exists(dirname(path))) {
        dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE)
      }
      readr::write_csv(coefficient_table, path)
      path
    },
    format = "file"
  ),

  # ---- Per-species plots ----
  tar_target(
    species_plot,
    make_scatter_plot_from_data(species_data),
    pattern = map(species_data)
  ),

  tar_target(
    combined_figure,
    patchwork::wrap_plots(species_plot, nrow = 1)
  ),

  tar_target(
    figure_png,
    {
      path <- here::here("outputs", "figures", "figure_1.png")
      if (!dir.exists(dirname(path))) {
        dir.create(dirname(path), recursive = TRUE)
      }
      ggplot2::ggsave(path, combined_figure,
                      width = 12, height = 4)
      path
    },
    format = "file"
  ),

  # ---- Tests ----
  tar_target(
    tests,
    testthat::test_file(
      here::here("tests", "test_modelling_functions.R"),
      reporter = "summary"
    )
  )
)
```



## Appendix D: Workshop setup script

For learners to run before the workshop begins.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# setup.R
# Run once before the workshop

required <- c("tidyverse", "broom", "here", "testthat",
              "palmerpenguins", "patchwork",
              "targets", "tarchetypes", "qs", "janitor")

missing <- required[!required %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing)
}

# Create the project structure
dirs <- c("data", "R/functions", "tests/fixtures",
          "outputs/figures", "outputs/tables", "reports",
          "exploratory")
for (d in dirs) {
  if (!dir.exists(here::here(d))) {
    dir.create(here::here(d), recursive = TRUE)
  }
}

# Write the penguins CSV
readr::write_csv(
  palmerpenguins::penguins,
  here::here("data", "penguins.csv")
)

# Write the test fixture
fixture <- palmerpenguins::penguins |>
  tidyr::drop_na(body_mass_g, flipper_length_mm, species) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 20, by = species)

saveRDS(
  fixture,
  here::here("tests", "fixtures", "penguins_test_subset.rds")
)

# Write a .gitignore
writeLines(
  c("_targets/", "exploratory/", ".Rproj.user/",
    ".Rhistory", ".RData", "renv/library/"),
  here::here(".gitignore")
)

message("Workshop setup complete.")
```
